description: This file is the implementation of a Timer plugin in C++ that manages starting, stopping, suspending, resuming, and monitoring timers. It interacts with external systems via IARM (Inter-Application Resource Management) for certain modes like sleep and wake, and defines RPC methods and events related to timer operations. The file includes methods for timer lifecycle management, notification dispatching, and state tracking.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class implementing timer management functionality, handling RPC methods, timer state updates, and system notifications.

methods.name: startTimerWrapper
methods.description: RPC method to start a new timer based on input parameters.

methods.name: cancelWrapper
methods.description: RPC method to cancel a specified timer.

methods.name: suspendWrapper
methods.description: RPC method to suspend a specified timer.

methods.name: resumeWrapper
methods.description: RPC method to resume a suspended timer.

methods.name: getTimerStatusWrapper
methods.description: RPC method to get the current status of a specific timer.

methods.name: getTimersWrapper
methods.description: RPC method to retrieve all timers.

methods.name: onTimerCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when the timer expires, checking and handling active timers.

methods.name: sendTimerExpired
methods.description: Notify system and possibly external systems that a timer expired.

methods.name: sendTimerExpiryReminder
methods.description: Send a reminder notification that a timer is about to expire.
